title: Phosphor cell

reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: A luminance scene sampled to a dot lattice, faulted on the lattice, then pushed through bloom and a phosphor saturation curve.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 736 × 1103 and every length scales with the canvas

pitch.does: Dot spacing. Coarser reads as signage, finer as video.

dotW.does: Narrow dots open the dark gaps between columns.

dotH.does: Tall dots fuse into vertical columns; short ones separate into beads.

levels.does: Steps of intensity per dot. 2 is one-bit.

heat.does: How far past saturation the type is driven. Sets the white core.

fuse.does: How far the overdriven type closes the gaps between its dots.

gain.does: Brightness of everything that is not the headline.

contrast.does: Gamma on the image before it reaches the lattice. High values leave only the highlights lit.

fill.does: Light leaking into the gaps between dots.

shade.does: A broad light field across the image, so parts of it sink into the dark.

focus.does: Softness of each dot. 0 is razor.

drip.does: Columns bleeding down from the underside of the type.

noise.does: Sensor grain over the whole frame.

weight.does: Thins or fattens the strokes before they hit the lattice.

stretch.does: How far a short line may be widened to reach the measure.

block.does: Rows of unreadable text under the image. 0 removes it.

seed.does: Re-rolls the subject and every fault.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Type
techniques.implementation: Headline core: cells with four lit neighbors fuse into a solid; the drive caps at Tc = 4 and every channel reads about 235 252 250.

techniques.name: Lattice
techniques.implementation: Rim of the G: edge cells take the 2.4 display gamma, so they drive to mint one cell wide while the interior fuses to white.

techniques.name: Glow
techniques.implementation: Halo above the type: 40 px veil, blue above green from 14 px out; the green glow is gone by 50 px.

techniques.name: Fault
techniques.implementation: Drips: columns under the type decay over 2 to 26 cells, one in three edge cells at the default.

techniques.name: Subject
techniques.implementation: Lit petal face: beads at 180 to 220 luminance, a hot rim where the petal edge faces the upper-left light.

pass_order: scene in gray at full resolution: the headline on a hot layer; the rose cluster (faces at a 0.75 gamma, the ring that faces the light 1.3 hotter, shadow sides at 0.15, creases at 0), registration marks and the type's own 12 px content glow on a cold layer

lattice: both layers averaged into 5.85 px cells; the data block written straight into cells as row gain (1.12 on the first row falling to 0.72) × per-column gain × a right-skewed residual, with 1 to 3 cell word gaps on about 20 % of cells and a one-row paragraph break at 0.6

faults on the lattice: drips under the type, persistence streaks down every column at 0.48 of the drive above, row slip, sparse dropout with a 14 % per-cell jitter, 9 brightness levels; cells under 0.15 of full drive fall to one dim level at 0.06, the display's floor

emission: one gaussian bead per cell, 0.35 cells wide and 0.8 tall; the type's coverage takes a display gamma of 2.4, so edge cells drive to mint and only interior cells with four lit neighbors fuse into solid white
optics: 0.18 px focus, then glow at 2.6, 8.25 and 40 px, the 40 px term also as a blue-white lens veil
phosphor saturation: green 1 − exp(−T); blue 1 − exp(−(0.16 T + 0.2 T²)); red 1 − exp(−(0.097 T^1.5 + 0.0059 T^4.2)); drive capped at Tc = 4 so the white core reads 235 252 250

lattice_pitch_px.method: autocorrelation peaks of the column and row profiles of the data block, lags 6, 12, 17 to 18

bead_fwhm_px.method: column profile 14→101→49 across one bead; row profile modulation 53 to 116 fitted to a gaussian bead

gap_to_peak_drive.method: gap pixel [1, 80, 24] and peak pixel [85, 190, 128] inverted through the green curve, the same in the block, the flower and a hot cluster

block_cells.method: 5 × 5 means at peak-aligned cell centers, 77 × 10 cells

flower_cells.method: cell maxima over 120..620 × 330..850; the render measures .43 / .13 / .05 / .36 / .03

glow_above_type.method: per-column profile above the first white pixel, 481 columns

phosphor_curves.method: R and B binned by G over the headline patch, T from the green curve

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, P1 green palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: The benchmark sets the type to the source wording so the type patch compares the same letters. The flower is generated, so the dot-field render rect was placed with search.py on a lit petal region with a shadow gap, the same material as the reference patch.

limits: The flower is generated and the reference's is a photograph: the dot-field patch is compared at a search-chosen rect; its histogram and contrast sit at 0.91 because the photograph's dim cells spread over 16 to 64 L where the render holds one dim level.

The reference is a JPEG whose quantization flattens dim lattice detail and softens the type's edge: the headline histogram and mint ink sit at 0.89 to 0.90, the data-block spectrum at 0.90; no blur was added to close that.

Archivo Black at +5 px stroke stands in for the reference's extended black sans, whose strokes measure 45 px with 18 px counters; the reference sets each line at its natural width (482 and 442 px) and the render justifies to one measure.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
